description:
Windows desktop app for downloading videos via yt-dlp, with a bundled FFmpeg for post-processing.

VideoDownloader is a Windows desktop app for downloading videos via yt-dlp, with a bundled custom FFmpeg for merging and remuxing. Paste a link or a list of links, pick a video/audio quality or let it auto-select the best available, and queue batch downloads with configurable concurrency, per-job progress, and cancel support. Every attempt is logged to a searchable download history with one-click redownload. Available in English and Polish, with Light/Dark/System UI themes.
Fixes
- yt-dlp.exe could disappear after upgrading (e.g. winget upgrade from 0.7.0 to 0.7.1), so the app showed "yt-dlp.exe was not found" / "Cannot find the file specified". The app updated the bundled yt-dlp.exe inside Program Files. That made it newer than the installer's copy, and Windows Installer then skipped it during the upgrade and removed the old one.
  yt-dlp now runs and updates itself from a per-user copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\APPIT\VideoDownloader. Updates work without admin rights and the installed files are never modified.
- Bundled yt-dlp updated to 2026.10.26.
If your 0.7.1 install is already missing yt-dlp.exe, upgrading to 0.7.2 restores it. You can also run winget repair APPIT.VideoDownloader.
Full changelog: v0.7.1...v0.7.2
